Dungeon Crawler Carl - Book One  -  v2

An unofficial fan game for the Nintendo DS. Dungeon Crawler Carl and
its characters belong to Matt Dinniman; no text from the books is
reproduced and every asset here was generated by code in the source
repository.

TO PLAY
  Copy "Dungeon Crawler Carl (v2).nds" to your card and open it in the DS emulator
  your device came with. No BIOS files, no DLDI patch, no save file --
  progress comes back through the recall code the kiosk prints, so it
  survives being carried between emulators.

COVER ART
  "Dungeon Crawler Carl (v2).png" is here twice: once beside the ROM and once in
  Imgs/, because front ends disagree about which they read. Delete
  whichever your one ignores. The icon and title your emulator shows
  come from inside the ROM and need no files at all.

CONTROLS
  D-pad   walk, four ways        A  act        B  back
  L / R   menu tabs              X  party      Y  quick heal
  Or play the whole game with the stylus on the bottom screen.
